children: Investors have sharply raised their expectations of Bank of England interest-rate increases over the coming months after Brent crude advanced above $109 a barrel. Markets see a 47% probability of a BOE rate rise at Thursday's policy decision, and fully price in two rate rises by year-end, LSEG data show. Traders are fully pricing in four BOE rate increases by April 2027, a notable increase from the two priced in a week ago, according to LSEG data. As a result, U.K. 2-year gilt yields have surged to 4.979%, their highest since 2023, the LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
